messages:
nina: Heads up team — planning a staggered rollout for the new flag arbitration layer. Aim: safety-first ramp for feature flags that change model routing. Proposal: 3 stages (canary:1%, warm:10%, full:100%) with automatic circuit-breakers and a tenant opt-out path. Thoughts?

rob: Love the stages. Suggest we add an internal shadow run for 48h before 1% canary to validate routing correctness (no user impact).

carlos: Agree. Also require a per-tenant override key so large customers can opt out immediately without waiting for flag removal. We need a documented API for that.

emma: Telemetry gating: latency.p95, errors.rate, cost.tokens_per_request, and quality.eval_regression. Gates per stage: canary -> p95 < 120ms and errors < 0.8%; warm -> p95 < 110ms and errors < 0.5%; full -> p95 < 100ms and errors < 0.3%. If any gate fails, rollback to previous stage and open incident.

nina: Ops constraints: reserve 5% spare capacity on Dedicated for the canary to avoid noisy-neighbor issues. Also prefer UTC 03:00 for first cutover.

rob: Rollback rules: immediate fallback to last-stable-model-route, not just disable the flag. Also add a grace-window where we double sample logs for 10 minutes to speed debugging.

carlos: Security/PKI note: per-tenant opt-out must be auditable. Log entries with admin id who toggled, timestamp, and reason.

emma: Implementation sketch for the flag config (conceptual, not full schema): ```yaml
flag: routing_arbitration_v1
stages:
  - name: shadow_run
    pct: 0
    duration: 48h
  - name: canary
    pct: 1
    duration: 24h
  - name: warm
    pct: 10
    duration: 7d
  - name: full
    pct: 100
fallback: last-stable-route
telemetry_keys: [latency.p95, errors.rate, tokens_per_request, eval.regression_delta]
circuits:
  p95_threshold_ms: 150
  errors_threshold_pct: 1.0
  evaluation_window_mins: 10
logging: double_sample_on_stage_fail: true
```

nina: Process items: 1) finalize flag naming and schema (rob) 2) ops reserve + deploy window (carlos) 3) dashboard + automated eval harness (emma) 4) docs + per-tenant opt-out API (product) 5) audit logging work (security). Target: shadow run by next week.

ops-bot: Preflight checklist created by @carlos. Capacity check pending; suggested window 2024-06-05 03:00 UTC.

rob: I'll open the flag PR and include deterministic bucketing tests. Also will add a small A/B inside warm stage to test two routing heuristics (latency-first vs cost-first).

carlos: I'll handle the reserve and the admin opt-out API spec. Need a short SLA doc for enterprise customers who opt out (how long it takes to reinstate routing).

emma: I'll wire up the dashboard metrics and add automatic alerts for stage failures. Pager on stage-failures -> eng-runtime oncall.

nina: Great. Let's keep thread updates short: post shadow-run start + 6h snapshot + 24h snapshot. Closing for now. Thanks everyone.
